# Design-system component catalog — pilot

Generated from `pilot.json` and the existing TypeScript sources. Do not edit this file or the generated JSON by hand.

Run `node scripts/design-catalog/generate.mjs --check` to validate/drift-check; use `--write` explicitly to regenerate after reviewing source/metadata changes.

- 7 selected entries in the repository pilot, not a complete component or route inventory; unlisted exports are unclassified.
- Status is curated adoption guidance, not proof that every variant meets accessibility or visual requirements.
- Examples are typechecked source compositions, not rendered stories. Evidence paths establish source existence, not executed results; the remediation ledger owns verification history.
- API details are source-derived; native React/DOM props are explicitly omitted. Defaults and runtime behavior are not inferred or evaluated.
- Compatibility replacements are review candidates, never automatic drop-in migrations.
- Evidence documents/test sources are reference-only and are not content-derived API inputs or execution attestations. Their paths, kinds and real containment are validated; edits to reference content alone do not require regeneration. Curated metadata and compiler inputs do.
- Dependency declaration provenance uses portable npm: paths, not host drive paths. Generated output paths reject symbolic links/junctions; this local tooling is not an adversarial filesystem sandbox.
- Input SHA-256 values hash UTF-8 TEXT after physical CRLF-to-LF normalization, not raw binary bytes. Artifact comparison and extracted API/JSDoc/tag line endings use the same policy. Literal escape sequences, other content and whitespace remain significant; tokens and binary font/assets are not transformed.

## KPICard — compatibility-review

Metric tile migrated to finite semantic presentation; consumer and rendered acceptance remain under review.

Import: `import { KPICard } from "@/design-system/patterns"`

Implementation: [src/design-system/patterns/KPICard.tsx:28](../../../src/design-system/patterns/KPICard.tsx#L28)

- The new API removes arbitrary paint/class overrides. Supply domain-owned values and explicit availability; tone must not infer academic classification. Source migration does not certify all consumers or rendered states.

Required review states: missing versus measured zero; native formatted values; all tones; light/dark/high contrast; long values; EN/AR; no hover lift.

Typed example: [LegacyKpiReference](../../../docs/design-system/catalog/examples/compatibility.tsx). **Not a rendered story.**

Static metric surface. Missing data is explicit; measured zero stays zero.
Invalid runtime values fail closed without turning a count into a status.

```ts
({ icon: Icon, label, value, tone, valueState, surface, }: KPICardProps): JSX.Element
```

Native properties omitted: 0. Native React/DOM properties are not expanded here. Consult the source types; this is a partial API summary.

## PreferenceToggle — recommended-scoped

Implementation: [src/design-system/patterns/PreferenceToggle.tsx:14](../../../src/design-system/patterns/PreferenceToggle.tsx#L14)
